Name: Alex's Sprite Edit - Pigs
Author: Alexsir94
Description:
This mod only alters the adult pig sprite.

Install [with Content Patcher]:
- Find your Stardew Valley folder
﻿On Steam right click Stardew Valley > Manage > Browse Local Files,
in this folder go to > Mods
- Unzip or extract the downloaded folder here
- There should now be a folder named "[CP] Alex's Sprite Edit - Pigs" or "[AT] Alex's Sprite Edit - Pigs" in the Mods folder
- Done!

Install [Manual] [i](No other mod needed)[/i]:
- Unzip or extract the folder after download
- Find your Stardew Valley folder
﻿On Steam right click Stardew Valley > Manage > Browse Local Files,
in this folder go to > Content > Animals
- Replace pig.xnb in corresponding folder with the ones from the download (make a copy of the
original .xnb file first if you want to revert the process later).
- Done!

[i]Changelog: v1.1 - Adds a version for Alternative Textures (AT) with 13 sprite variations (use scissors from Robin), these might change.[/i]
